knowledge.textEn: Extend the translation motivation for huge pages by calculating ideal TLB reach. Sufficient aggregate reach does not guarantee zero misses because associativity, replacement and separate page-size structures still matter.

knowledge.textEn: Build a table of page size, entry count, working-window size and access stride. Mark real-processor fields as unmeasured so the hypothetical entry counts cannot be mistaken for discovered hardware properties.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 理想完全相聯且同頁面大小的 reach 為 entry_count*page_size；比較工作視窗時必須使用相同二進位單位。
knowledge.textEn: Under a fully associative, single-page-size idealization, reach equals entry count times page size. Use consistent binary units and keep this capacity bound distinct from measured miss behavior.
